description: Verified evaluation metrics parsed directly from saved evaluation outputs. Zero API calls.

kpis.label: Genuine Circular Purity
kpis.limitation: In-sample rule tuning on genuine official corpus; circulars with personal contact or non-gov webmail may trigger warnings.

kpis.label: Leave-One-Out Debunk Match
kpis.sample_size: 72 repeated fake notices with sister debunks (90 total in index)
kpis.limitation: 18 of 90 fake notices in the index are singleton narratives without a sister debunk; they cannot match in LOO mode.

kpis.label: Synthetic Forgery Detection
kpis.limitation: Small sample: only 4 of 60 generated synthetic circulars are in OCR cache; 56 remain un-OCR'd.

kpis.label: Held-out Genuine Safety
kpis.limitation: Only 10 of 35 held-out documents are cached; 11 fakes (TF-01..11) and 2 fresh scans have no OCR text.

datasets.description: 12 real-world fake circulars collected as PIB Fact Check graphics (MHA, RBI, PM-KUSUM, Mudra, OMC, I4C). Used to calibrate overlay filtering and forensic heuristics.
79 official circulars, orders, and press releases across RBI, CBSE, SEBI, and MoHFW with bilingual Hindi/English reference formats.
105 fake claims across 7 Indian languages plus 15 true control claims mapped to known PIB debunk clusters.
4 cached synthetic circulars (SYN-0001, SYN-0002 clean; SYN-0031, SYN-0033 forged) out of 60 generated files.
10 cached genuine circulars (TR-02 to TR-11) evaluated in unseen mode with 0 false alarms. 25 items remain un-OCR'd.

forensics_genuine.label: Genuine Circular Purity
forensics_genuine.limitation: In-sample rule tuning on genuine official corpus; circulars with personal contact or non-gov webmail may trigger warnings.

forensics_synthetic.label: Synthetic Forgery Detection
forensics_synthetic.limitation: Small sample: only 4 of 60 generated synthetic circulars are in OCR cache; 56 remain un-OCR'd.

retrieval_loo.label: Leave-One-Out Debunk Match
retrieval_loo.sample_size: 72 repeated fake notices with sister debunks (90 total in index)
retrieval_loo.limitation: 18 of 90 fake notices in the index are singleton narratives without a sister debunk; they cannot match in LOO mode.

retrieval_controls.label: True Controls Precision
retrieval_controls.sample_size: 15 negative control claims across English, Hindi, and Hinglish
retrieval_controls.limitation: Tested against templated synthetics; real-world noisy social media claims may carry ambiguous phrasing.

heldout_testset.label: Held-out Genuine Safety
heldout_testset.limitation: Only 10 of 35 held-out documents are cached; 11 fakes (TF-01..11) and 2 fresh scans have no OCR text.
